deposit_metadata.title: BioInterfaceOS v0.1.3-r10.47: full-text paper-data route and external-evidence handoff
deposit_metadata.description: Immutable public version containing the T263 full-text data-route consolidation, a paper-derived 141-subject biological-cohort OOD audit, source-conditional common-target evidence, explicit candidate exclusions and the non-author external-gate handoff boundary.

upload_instructions: Upload the exact archive and sidecar from the authenticated archive workflow.
Upload the hash-bound manifest as a separate archive file because it was generated from the immutable tag and intentionally excluded from its self-hash.
Record the archive service DOI, version DOI, immutable record URL and upload timestamp.
Read back the archived manifest bytes and archive bytes; compare both SHA-256 values exactly.
Only after authenticated read-back may doi_archived be changed to true and CITATION.cff be updated.
claim_boundary: This metadata is a deposit preparation artifact, not a DOI or archive receipt. Git tags, GitHub releases and KAUST archives do not close doi_archived or scientific_submission_ready.
